title: Policy Note
---

# Travel policy

Employees may book economy travel for journeys under six hours.[^1] Longer
journeys may be booked in premium economy with manager approval.[^2]

Accommodation is reimbursed at the published rate for the destination.[^3]

[^1]: Journey time is measured from scheduled departure to scheduled arrival.
[^2]: Approval must be recorded before booking.
[^3]: Rates are reviewed each January and published on the intranet.
